title: Kicked Caramelized Jamaican Fernbrake Skillet
description: A pungent and gooey post-workout Jamaican dish featuring caramelized fernbrake, this skillet is perfect for a hearty meal, it is whole30-friendly and packed with nutrients.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the fernbrake and cook until it is tender and caramelized, stirring occasionally.
Add the chicken breast and cook until it is browned and cooked through.
Add the jamaican jerk seasoning, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
